tavily.note: Optional live web-search MCP for Ava/Rex. Prefer PBK_TAVILY_API_KEY in the hosted bridge env for /api/brain/web-search; never commit a real Tavily key here.

browseros.note: Optional browser-native research layer for Rex. Keep surfaced inside the Brain and Settings tooling cards.

human-mcp.note: Optional multimodal layer for Ava/Rex. Requires at least one provider key in the OpenClaw parent environment. Do not hardcode secrets here.

n8n-mcp.note: Production n8n MCP endpoint for PBK workflow tools. Do not commit the real bearer token.
